connector.name: Laxis
connector.registryDescription: Search and read your Laxis meeting transcripts, AI summaries, and participants from Claude.
connector.summary: Hosted at app.laxis.tech over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the laxis-tech account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Laxis personal API key as a Bearer token (e.g. 'Bearer laxis_...'). Generate one at app.laxis.tech -> Settings -> Claude (MCP).
